options.removeCloudyTitle: Removes cloud-flagged days (shown as gray dots) from the series
options.windowTitle: Window size for Savitzky-Golay smoothing (odd number >= 5, larger = smoother)
options.orderTitle: Polynomial order (>= 1, must be less than window size)
options.dotsTitle: Show or hide the per-observation dots (line is always shown)

info.dots: Each dot is one observation. Colored dots are clear-day observations (one color per series). Gray dots are observations flagged as cloudy.
info.removeCloudy: Remove cloudy drops the gray observations from both the raw series and the smoothed line.
info.smooth: Smooth fits a Savitzky-Golay filter. If you leave cloudy points in, the filter pulls the smoothed line toward them - usually Remove cloudy + Smooth together is what you want.
info.showDots: Dots toggles whether the per-observation markers are drawn.

task.authoritativeUnassignedTitle: Submit as authoritative: this task isn't assigned to you, but your label will be recorded as the canonical answer and the task will be marked completed without needing consensus from assignees.

task.authoritativeToggleTitle: Submit as authoritative: your label overrides other annotators and completes the task.
